verdicts.reason: Both crop the photo so the heart mug and gift box (the product) are cut off at the right edge, shrink the copy column to small text with a big dead gap above the headline, and add stray dividers. A also adds a second rule under LYGOM CAFE, a solid line right under 'A GIFT' that doubles up with the dotted rule, and stars blown up so large they pull focus from the message. B keeps the stars at their original small size but frames 'Only this Christmas' between two extra rules that aren't in the original, so it's slightly less damaged.
